name: Hungry Ghosts
source:
Lucinda Baudelaire has just moved into a manor with her aunt, and has an encounter with a sad ghost who has no memory of herself. Who is this mysterious, young ghost? It's up to Lucinda to help.

[From[url=http://foggywaters.weebly.com/] foggywaters[/url]]
